ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Acknowledge_Date__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New')), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Backlog'), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(Ready_for_Testing__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Solution_Provided__c)))), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'On Hold'), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(Ready_for_Testing__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Solution_Provided__c)))), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Assigned - In Progress'), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(Ready_for_Testing__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Solution_Provided__c)))), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Ready to Test'), NOT(ISBLANK(Solution_Provided__c))), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Escalated'), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(Ready_for_Testing__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Solution_Provided__c)))) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $Permission.Operations_Access)
